messages:
maria: heads up — onboarding sampleapp streaming seems to hang at the generator handshake step. repro in local with intermittent network drops.

alex: ugh, seen something similar last week. can you paste the minimal logs?

maria: pasted below. go sample app -> StartGeneratorStream(ctx) then nothing, ctx cancel doesn't close.

sam: can you share the run command? are you using our go sdk v0.12.1 or main?

maria: v0.12.1 (released), command: `go run ./cmd/sampleapp -mode=stream -token=$TOKEN`

maria: logs:
```
2026-03-20T14:03:12Z INFO starting generator stream
2026-03-20T14:03:12Z DEBUG sending client hello
2026-03-20T14:03:12Z DEBUG waiting for server ack
# network blip -> nothing received
# ctx cancelled by user at 14:03:17
2026-03-20T14:03:17Z INFO context cancelled, waiting for stream close
# nothing; process stuck
```

priya: does the server accept an unauthenticated first frame? python sdk auto-sends an auth frame before the stream op. go sdk's generator currently expects the stream op to carry auth metadata and then waits for server to ack. if network drops at that moment we can get stuck because we never send a follow-up frame or a ping.

alex: right — parity note: python: send_auth_frame(); send_start(); go: send_start() with auth in metadata. if start gets lost the server has partial state and client waits.

sam: quick workaround: wrap StartGeneratorStream in a goroutine and select on ctx.Done to close the underlying conn. but that's ugly.

maria: here's a tiny patch I tried locally that fixes it: set a read deadline on the stream socket and treat missing server ack as an error to abort. snippet:
```
// pseudo
conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(5*time.Second))
err := waitForServerAck()
if err != nil {
  conn.Close()
  return fmt.Errorf("handshake timeout: %w", err)
}
```

priya: acceptable as interim but we should fix ergonomics in the SDK. proposal: 1) make go sdk send an explicit auth frame before Start; 2) ensure StartGeneratorStream listens to ctx.Done and closes stream proactively; 3) add small handshake timeout default (configurable).

alex: +1. also add a sampleapp test that simulates packet loss and shows proper cancellation. this'll prevent regressions.

maria: opened PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/4321 — implements 2 + 3 and adds doc note. still experimenting with 1.

ci-bot: build passed for PR #4321 (linux-amd64) :white_check_mark:

sam: can we add an explicit example in quickstarts/ generating/streaming.md showing correct context/cancel pattern? users keep tripping over this.

priya: yes — I'll add a short snippet: `ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Second); defer cancel(); gen, err := client.StartGeneratorStream(ctx, opts)` and a note about network heuristics.

alex: also file a small internal issue to audit other SDKs for handshake parity (python, js, rust). we need consistent server expectations.

maria: thanks all — marking this as actionable. will follow up in PR comments with reproducible steps for the eng-oncall to run. :thumbsup:

alex: nice find. once PR lands, let's add a tiny e2e in CI that simulates the blip.

maria: last note — sampleapp onboarding doc needs to warn about cloud VPNs that pause TCP for a bit during startup. added that to the PR description.

priya: good call.

sam: resolving on my side after PR merge.

maria: thanks!
